title: Has Performance Max improved in 2026?
transcript: Performance Max better than it was a year ago? Yes, I think so. I don't think we're seeing the same level of improvement as we did when it was first launched. Year over year, I feel continuing to see improvements. What we're seeing, the way I would judge that is we very often recommend that advertisers move from just search, which is typically what a lot of advertisers do, or say just shopping, and add an performance Max campaign. And I would say a higher proportion of those are out performing their existing campaign than they would have done a year ago. And because of that, I think be fairly confident in saying performance is getting better.
